<!--
Analysis code accompanying the manuscript.
 
Compares mutational age between colibactin-positive and colibactin-negative
individuals, and generates Figure 2A.
 
Mutational age is defined here as a crypt's mutation burden divided by the
age-related background accumulation rate for that colonic location, giving the
chronological age at which that burden would be expected under background
mutagenesis alone.
 -->
 
```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo       = TRUE,
  message    = FALSE,
  warning    = FALSE,
  comment    = "#>",
  fig.path   = "../Figures/",
  fig.width  = 7,
  fig.height = 4,
  dpi        = 300
)
 
set.seed(42)
```
 
## Dependencies
 
```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)    # dplyr, tidyr, stringr, forcats, tibble, ggplot2
library(lmerTest)     # linear mixed models with Satterthwaite p-values
library(broom.mixed)  # tidy() for merMod objects
```
 
## Data
 
```{r paths}
data_dir <- file.path("..", "Data")
fig_dir  <- file.path("..", "Figure2/")
 
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
```
 
```{r load-data}
crypt_metadata <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "biopsy_metadata.csv"))
crypt_signature_attributions <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "crypt_signature_attributions.csv"))
background_summary_rates_df <- read.csv(file.path(data_dir, "background_mutation_rates.csv"))
```
 
# A. Mutational age
 
## A.i. Build the mutational age table
 
Crypts are restricted to the large bowel and to those with an indel median VAF
above 0.3, i.e. clonal samples in which the indel burden can be estimated
reliably. Locations are collapsed into the three groups for which background
rates were derived.
 
 
```{r mutational-age-df}
mutational_age_df <- left_join(
    crypt_metadata, crypt_signature_attributions,
    by = c("patient", "biopsy")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(!location %in% c('Caecum','Rectum',"Terminal Ileum")) %>%
  filter(indel_median_vaf > 0.3) %>%
 
  # per-crypt totals for each mutation class, and collapsed location groups
  mutate(
    SBS = SBS1 + SBS5 + SBS18 + SBS88 + SBS89,
    ID  = indel_total_burden,
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    patient, biopsy, cohort, sample, location, site, SBS, ID, age,
    biopsy_colibactin_pos, biopsy_SBS89_ID83C_pos
  ) %>%
 
  # long format, one row per crypt per mutation class
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = c("SBS", "ID"),
    names_to  = "mut_type",
    values_to = "mutation"
  ) %>%
 
  # background rate for the matching location / mutation class
  left_join(background_summary_rates_df, by = c("location", "mut_type")) %>%
  mutate(mutational_age = mutation / Estimate)
```
 
## A.ii. Summarise to biopsy level for plotting
 
```{r plot-data}
plot_mutational_age <- mutational_age_df %>%
  group_by(biopsy, mut_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mutational_age        = mean(mutational_age, na.rm = TRUE),
    patient               = dplyr::first(patient),
    age                   = min(age, na.rm = TRUE),
    site                  = dplyr::first(site),
    cohort                = dplyr::first(cohort),
    crypts                = n(),
    biopsy_colibactin_pos = any(biopsy_colibactin_pos),
    biopsy_SBS89_ID83C_pos = any(biopsy_SBS89_ID83C_pos),
    .groups               = "drop"
  ) %>%
 
  # mutational processes present, in order of precedence
  mutate(
    signature_annotation = case_when(
      biopsy_colibactin_pos ~ "colibactin_mutagenesis",
      biopsy_SBS89_ID83C_pos ~ "SBS89_ID83C_mutagenesis",
      .default = "only_background_mutagenesis"
    )
  ) %>%
 
  # indels are plotted downwards, so their values are negated and the y-axis
  # is relabelled with abs() in the scale below
  mutate(mutational_age = if_else(mut_type == "ID", -mutational_age, mutational_age)) %>%
 
  # factor levels controlling facet and axis order
  arrange(biopsy) %>%
  mutate(
    mut_type = factor(if_else(mut_type == "SBS", "SBS", "Indel"),
                      levels = c("SBS", "Indel")),
    site     = factor(site, levels = c("Left", "Right")),
    patient  = factor(patient)
  )
```
 
X-axis labels: biopsies are ordered by donor age, and a tick is labelled only
where the age changes, to avoid overplotting repeated ages.
 
```{r axis-labels}
age_labs <- mutational_age_df %>%
  distinct(biopsy, age, site) %>%
  arrange(site, age) %>%
  mutate(
    age       = round(age, digits = 0),
    age_label = if_else(is.na(lag(age)) | age != lag(age), as.character(age), "")
  ) %>%
  arrange(age)
 
age_labels <- setNames(age_labs$age_label, age_labs$biopsy)
age_labels <- age_labels[age_labels != ""]
age_breaks <- names(age_labels)
```
 
## A.iii. Figure 2A

```{r fig2a-mutational-age, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 8}
# y positions of the cohort annotation points, just outside the bar range in
# each facet (SBS bars are positive, indel bars negative)
cohort_point_y <- c(SBS = -1.5, Indel = 5)
 
fig2a <- ggplot(
    plot_mutational_age,
    aes(x = fct_reorder(biopsy, age), y = mutational_age, fill = signature_annotation)
  ) +
 
  # cohort annotation, one point per biopsy in each facet row
  geom_point(
    data = filter(plot_mutational_age, mut_type == "SBS"),
    aes(y = cohort_point_y[["SBS"]], shape = cohort),
    colour = "black", size = 2
  ) +
  geom_point(
    data = filter(plot_mutational_age, mut_type == "Indel"),
    aes(y = cohort_point_y[["Indel"]], shape = cohort),
    colour = "black", size = 2
  ) +
 
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 0.7) +
 
  facet_grid(
    mut_type ~ site,
    scales = "free", space = "free_x", switch = "y",
    labeller = labeller(
      mut_type = as_labeller(c(
        Indel = "ID 'Mutational Age' [years]",
        SBS   = "SBS 'Mutational Age' [years]"
      )),
      site = as_labeller(c(
        Left  = "Colon Left Side",
        Right = "Colon Right Side"
      ))
    )
  ) +
 
  scale_y_continuous(labels = abs) +
  scale_x_discrete(breaks = age_breaks, labels = age_labels) +
  scale_shape_manual(
    breaks = c("Normal", "IBD"),
    values = c(Normal = NA, IBD = 1),
    labels = c("", "Inflammatory Bowel Disease")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    breaks = c("colibactin_mutagenesis", "SBS89_ID83C_mutagenesis", "only_background_mutagenesis"),
    values = c("maroon3", "#5cdf02ff", "bisque3"),
    labels = c("Colibactin Mutagenesis", "SBS89 / ID83C Mutagenesis", "Only Background Mutagenesis")
  ) +
 
  labs(
    x     = "Chronological Age of Donor at Time of Biopsy Acquisition [years]",
    fill  = "Mutational Processes Present",
    shape = ""
  ) +
 
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 14.5, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title.x      = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y      = element_blank(),
    strip.background  = element_blank(),
    strip.placement.y = "outside",
    strip.placement.x = "inside",
    panel.spacing.x   = grid::unit(0.9, "cm"),
    panel.spacing.y   = grid::unit(0, "cm"),
    legend.position   = "bottom",
    strip.text.x      = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y      = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    legend.title      = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text       = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )
 
fig2a
 
ggsave(
  file.path(fig_dir, "mutational_age_colibactin_frequency.svg"),
  fig2a,
  width = 16, height = 8, bg = "transparent"
)
```
 
## A.iv. Comparison of mutational age by colibactin status
 
Mutational age is compared between colibactin-positive and colibactin-negative
biopsies, separately for each colonic side and each mutation class, with random
intercepts for patient and cohort.
 
```{r comparison-data}
compare_mutation_age_df <- mutational_age_df %>%
  # keep only the columns needed to identify a crypt, so that the join with the
  # background rates cannot introduce extra columns and break pivot_wider
  dplyr::select(
    patient, biopsy, sample, cohort, site, age,
    biopsy_colibactin_pos, mut_type, mutational_age
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = mut_type, values_from = mutational_age)
```
 
```{r comparison-models}
# Fit one model per side x mutation class and return the colibactin effect with
# a Wald 95% confidence interval. Coefficients are extracted by name rather
# than by position.
fit_mutational_age_model <- function(side, response, data) {
  model_formula <- reformulate(
    c("biopsy_colibactin_pos", "(1 | cohort)", "(1 | patient)"),
    response = response
  )
 
  model <- lmer(model_formula, data = filter(data, site == side))
 
  tidy(model, effects = "fixed") %>%
    filter(startsWith(term, "biopsy_colibactin_pos")) %>%
    transmute(
      site      = side,
      mut_type  = response,
      estimate  = round(estimate,0),
      low_ci    = round(estimate - 1.96 * std.error,0),
      upp_ci    = round(estimate + 1.96 * std.error,0),
      p.value   = round(p.value,3)
    )
}
 
mutational_age_results <- expand_grid(
    side     = c("Left", "Right"),
    response = c("SBS", "ID")
  ) %>%
  pmap_dfr(function(side, response) {fit_mutational_age_model(side, response, compare_mutation_age_df) })
 
mutational_age_results
```
 
```{r comparison-summary}
mutational_age_results %>%
  mutate(
    summary = sprintf(
      "%s %s mutational age: %.0f [%.0f, %.0f] years, P = %s",
      site, mut_type, estimate, low_ci, upp_ci, format.pval(p.value, digits = 3)
    )
  ) %>%
  pull(summary) %>%
  walk(~ cat(.x, "\n"))
```
 
## A.v. Mutational ages for PD69095 and PD68018
 
```{r example-donors}
plot_mutational_age %>%
  filter(str_detect(biopsy, "PD69095|PD68018")) %>%
  mutate(mutational_age = round(abs(mutational_age),0)) %>%
  dplyr::select(biopsy, site, age, mut_type, mutational_age) %>%
  arrange(biopsy, mut_type)
```
